# Aurex

> ROI-first growth partner for local service businesses — med spas, home services, and health practices. Based in North Mississippi, serving clients nationwide.

Aurex helps local service businesses grow predictable revenue through paid acquisition, lead nurture, and retention systems. We work on retainer ($500–$2,500/mo) and offer a loyalty program ($300/mo + $300 setup).

- [Home Services](/home-services): Lead generation and retention for home service businesses.
- [Health Practices](/health-practices): Patient acquisition systems for health practices.
- [Results](/results): Client case studies and reviews from businesses in Nashville, Tupelo, Oxford, and Atlanta.
